_lisez_moi: Known-good versions of the C++ engines, read by scripts/install_windows.ps1 (key 'windows') and scripts/install_unix.sh (keys 'linux', 'macos-arm64', 'macos-x64'). Maintained by the watch (scripts/veille_versions.py) and validated updates (AGENTS.md process). 'epingle' pins a specific version when the newest ones cause problems; otherwise 'release': 'latest' or 'scan_releases' takes the latest upstream publication. Key 'sha256' (optional): fingerprint of the resolved asset - mandatory for pinned assets, to refresh at every pin/release change (source: digest field of the GitHub API); installers verify it after download and refuse a modified asset. For 'latest'/'scan_releases' cards without a sha256, installers use the digest returned by the API at resolution time. No sha256 possible on moving direct URLs (ffmpeg BtbN 'latest'). GPU backend: Vulkan everywhere, Metal on macOS. trellis.cpp is not published for macOS (source build required). The installed FFmpeg is a STANDARD build (BtbN Windows/Linux, Homebrew macOS) covering 100% of the repo's recipes; the workstation's custom build (AMF, libfdk-aac, cpu=native) is machine-specific and nonfree hence NOT redistributable.
